string.text: Muzzle compensator
Installation of a special attachment on the barrel that partially compensates for the recoil of the weapon when firing.
High pressure barrel

The barrel, made using a unique technology, has a special groove and creates increased pressure inside itself when fired.Thanks to this, destabilization of the bullet in flight is achieved, which forces it to enter the target’s body at an arbitrary angle.When hit by such a weapon, the victim receives truly monstrous damage, usually incompatible with life.Unfortunately, due to destabilization, shooting accuracy decreases, and higher pressure leads to stronger recoil.
Alteration of the holder

Due to high shock loads and vibration during shots, standard holding devices soon begin to loosely fix the magazine, which leads to misfires.The modernization of the retainer is intended to solve this problem.
Barrel adjustment
Allows you to achieve a more stable bullet flight, which helps to increase shooting accuracy.
Light alloy magazine
Allows you to get a small gain in the weight of the weapon.It’s a small thing, but it’s nice, especially considering that the gun itself is quite heavy.
Mass Balancing
Installing counterweights in the weapon body according to the individual preferences of the shooter allows you to compensate for recoil and achieve better results when shooting.
USM calibration
Individual fitting and balancing of standard parts of the firing mechanism allows for higher shooting accuracy while reducing recoil.
Rail fastening
Installing an additional rail on a weapon expands the possibilities of its tactical use, opening up the possibility of installing additional modules.
Combined tactical module
Combines the functions of a highly targeted tactical flashlight and a laser target designator.Particularly useful at night.
Tritium inserts
Installing luminous inserts in sights allows you to increase the speed of aiming and the convenience of firing in the dark.
Chamber adjustment
Allows you to achieve higher shooting accuracy.
Protective coating
Applying a special coating to internal parts helps slow down the wear of the weapon.
Forcing USM
Reconfiguring the trigger and modifying some of its parts makes the trigger travel shorter and the trigger itself softer.This allows you to fire at a higher rate.
Recoil compensation system
Allows you to significantly reduce recoil, facilitating more accurate shooting.
Adjusting the locking mechanism
By locking the bore more tightly, the obturation of the bore improves and the muzzle velocity of the bullet increases.
Protective coating
Applying a special coating to internal parts helps slow down the wear of the weapon.
Modification of the gas exhaust system
Allows you to reduce the recoil felt by the shooter.
Polymer parts
The introduction of lightweight polymer analogues into the design instead of standard metal parts can significantly reduce the weight of the weapon.
Rubberized handle
Selecting and installing grip pads that are more suitable for a particular shooter on a weapon allows you to achieve better results when shooting.
Titanium trigger
Replacing standard trigger parts with their heavy-duty titanium counterparts significantly increases the wear resistance of the weapon.
